# MM-P3-L3-CN02-S1 Lubrication and fluids - Machining CNC turning center #2

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P3, line P3-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L3-CN02

Scope
This document prescribes lubrication and fluid handling for Machining CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P3-L3-CN02). It covers way lube refill and verification activities required to maintain reliability and surface finish on P3-L3 production equipment. Follow associated work methods in SOP-P3-L3-01, SOP-P3-L3-03, and SOP-P3-L3-05.

Tools
- Clean lint-free rags
- Approved refill funnel
- Spill containment tray
- Personal protective equipment as required by SOP-P3-L3-03
- Equipment-level lubrication log for EQ-P3-L3-CN02

Procedure
- Verify machine is in a safe state per SOP-P3-L3-01 before beginning lubrication tasks.
- Inspect the way lube reservoir and lines for contamination, leaks, and proper routing. Contain any fluid on the spill containment tray and clean per SOP-P3-L3-05.
- The way lube refill interval for Machining CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P3-L3-CN02) is 70 hours. Record runtime on the equipment-level lubrication log and schedule the next refill per that interval.
- Use only the approved lubricant. The lubricant part number for Machining CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P3-L3-CN02) is CFW-LUB-611. Confirm part number on the container before dispensing.
- With the approved refill funnel, add lubricant until the reservoir level reaches the manufacturer’s fill mark. Wipe splashes immediately and dispose of rags per SOP-P3-L3-05.
- Cycle the carriage and visually confirm even distribution of way lube across guideways. Note any irregularities on the equipment-level lubrication log and notify maintenance per SOP-P3-L3-01.

Acceptance criteria
- Way lube reservoir is filled using CFW-LUB-611 and shows no visible contamination or leaks.
- Refill was performed at the interval specified: 70 hours from the previous refill, documented on the lubrication log for EQ-P3-L3-CN02.
- No residual spills remain; any used absorbents are disposed of according to SOP-P3-L3-05.
- Machine passes a functional carriage movement check with even film coverage; discrepancies are documented and routed to maintenance per SOP-P3-L3-01.
